findings.what_the_code_does: Line 30 sets `local newv "true_cleaned"`, and line 37 overrides it with `local newv "$FIG_NEWLINKS"` (`"mltgt1940"`) when `$FIG_NEWLINKS` is `"mltgt1940"`. Line 95 then runs `merge 1:1 id_B using "`intermediate'link`beg_yr'_1940_`newv'_noraceblock`linksuf'.dta"`, which expands to `link1930_1940_mltgt1940_noraceblock0.dta` (without `_cleaned`), whereas the file produced by `MATCHING/_tgt_only_run.do` and `MATCHING/3_append_and_clean_all_links_christian_torbenV2.do:149` is `link1930_1940_mltgt1940_cleaned_noraceblock0.dta`.
findings.why_it_matters: Running `MATCHING/_figs_tgt_run.do` will abort with `r(601)` (file not found) at `CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:95` after spending ~30 minutes loading the 122.5M-record 1940 census file, sorting by enumeration district, and merging the socio-demographic extract and baseline links. findings.title: Writing *_tgt.tex into replication/results/ with identical repnum keys breaks check_claims.py and Run-MachineA.ps1
findings.what_the_code_does: `CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:40` and `CODE/compute_legibility_quartiles.do:27` open `$REP_RESULTS/create_figures_SSHA2025_tgt.tex` and `$REP_RESULTS/compute_legibility_quartiles_tgt.tex` in `replication/results/` and write the exact same `repnum` LaTeX command keys (`\nRecordsTarget`, `\linkRateTargetBefore`, `\legDisagreeLowest`, etc.) as `create_figures_SSHA2025.tex` and `compute_legibility_quartiles.tex`. `replication/check_claims.py:40-47` globs all `*.tex` in `replication/results/` and exits with an error on any duplicate key across files, and `replication/Run-MachineA.ps1:77` checks `git -C $repo status --porcelain -- replication/results/` without `--untracked-files=no`.
findings.why_it_matters: Once `MATCHING/_figs_tgt_run.do` creates `replication/results/*_tgt.tex`, every subsequent run of `python replication/check_claims.py` will crash immediately with `duplicate result key`, and `replication/Run-MachineA.ps1` will fail both at the claim check and at its dirty-results check.

review_limits: No paper or slide draft text was provided for this review; claims-vs-code could not verify slide text against the target-only figures and numbers.

The Stata pipeline was not executed in this read-only review session; runtime behaviour was verified from source code and existing batch logs (replication/run_machineA.log, MATCHING/_tgt_only_run.log, MATCHING/score_tgt_links.log).
summary: The target-only switch in `CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do` and `CODE/compute_legibility_quartiles.do` preserves all default paths and behaviour when `$FIG_NEWLINKS` is empty, and properly suffixes the paper figures, table, and `temp.dta` when set. However, there is one blocker bug and one major replication conflict when `$FIG_NEWLINKS` is set to `mltgt1940`: `CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:37,95` sets `newv` to `"mltgt1940"` instead of `"mltgt1940_cleaned"`, so the merge looks for a non-existent `link1930_1940_mltgt1940_noraceblock0.dta` and will abort with `r(601)` after loading the 43 GB census file. In addition, writing `*_tgt.tex` with identical `repnum` keys into `replication/results/` will cause `replication/check_claims.py` to exit on duplicate keys and `replication/Run-MachineA.ps1` to fail its clean-results check.

verified_clean.evidence: When `$FIG_NEWLINKS` is empty, `newv` is `"true_cleaned"` and `sfx` is `""` in `CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:30-39` and `CODE/compute_legibility_quartiles.do:19-26`; every input and output path across `CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:40,95,113,124,152,274,277,281,296,307,415,418,421` and `CODE/compute_legibility_quartiles.do:27,34` expands byte-for-byte identically to `HEAD`.
verified_clean.item: Default behaviour and file paths when global FIG_NEWLINKS is empty

verified_clean.evidence: When `$FIG_NEWLINKS` is `"mltgt1940"`, `sfx` is `"_tgt"`, which suffixes `temp_tgt.dta` (`CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:113,124,307`, `CODE/compute_legibility_quartiles.do:34`), `avg_performance_allstates_tgt.tex` (`CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:152`), and all seven PDF exports (`CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:274,277,281,296,415,418,421`), leaving the paper's tracked figures, table, and `temp.dta` untouched.
verified_clean.item: Suffix isolation of paper figures, avg_performance_allstates.tex, and temp.dta under FIG_NEWLINKS=mltgt1940

verified_clean.evidence: `MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:111-114` sets `mi_true_cleaned` in `divided_file1940_tgt_cleaned` to the model initial on target records (`tgt==1`) and `mi_ans` on non-target records (`!tgt`), verified by `assert r(N)==0` in `MATCHING/score_tgt_links.do:103-108` (`MATCHING/score_tgt_links.log:355-366`). `MATCHING/3_append_and_clean_all_links_christian_torbenV2.do:129-141` attaches `mi1930` from `divided_file1930_ans_cleaned` and `mi1940` (`mi_true_cleaned`) from `divided_file1940_tgt_cleaned` into `link1930_1940_mltgt1940_cleaned_noraceblock0.dta`, matching the exact convention used by `MATCHING/score_tgt_links.do:210-215`.

In Stata 15 batch mode (`/b`), the batch log (`_run_<name>.log`) is distinct from the user `log` handle: `capture log close` at `CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:1` and `log using` / `log close` at `CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:355,387` do not close or interrupt the batch log, as confirmed in `replication/run_machineA.log:308,1173-1246,3573` where `RUN-STATA-RC: 0` was written and parsed by `replication/Run-Stata.ps1:58`.
verified_clean.item: Compatibility of capture log close and inner log using/close with Run-Stata.ps1 batch logging
